shots.name: chroma-key-inspector
shots.alt: Properties, Effects with a Chroma Key card: Preset menu showing Fine Hair, then the Key section (Screen: Green, View: Final result), Matte (Clip Black 0.15, Clip White 0.95), Edge (Shrink / Grow and Softness at 0 px) and Spill (Suppression 1.00, Method: Neutral), beside a strip of the preview with the keyed dancer
shots.caption: Chroma Key with the Fine Hair preset. 1 — Preset: pick a starting point. 2 — Screen: the colour to key. 3 — View: the result or the matte. 4 — Clip Black: background away. 5 — Shrink / Grow: the edge in or out.
